completion:
Reflect on short and long term effects.
3. Determine any health insurance or worker's comp claims inflight or filed.
4. Determine if the injury recordable under OSHA 300 or Cal/OSHA 300.
5. If the injury is not recordable, discard.
6. If the injury is recordable complete the EHSIRForm.
7. Forward to the plant EHS Manager and CORA EHS for processing to the EHS Manager in charge.

## Work-Relatedness

Work-related means there existed an exposure or event at the workplace.

Any illness or injury that stems from the responsibilities or duties of work is considered to be work-related even if the actual exposure or event happened outside of the work location. Examples: lung disease caused by dust exposure at work.
